## Contribution checklist

- [ ] Manifest validates and all listed files are included.
- [ ] Source order and optional sample data are correct.
- [ ] Images have alt text and accurate captions.
- [ ] Author/contact and license are accurate.
- [ ] I have permission to publish the code and images.
- [ ] No credentials or private data are included.
- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run build` pass.
